name: Ahmed Maher
title: Senior Flutter Engineer · Team Lead
summary: Senior Flutter engineer with 6+ years shipping cross-platform products and 3 years leading a delivery team. Currently technical lead on a three-app realtime transport platform — background GPS tracking, offline-first sync and WebSocket live maps — alongside a bilingual marketplace live on both stores. {appCount} apps published to Google Play and the App Store. Works end to end: architecture, state management, API integration, CI/CD and store release, with a bias toward clean architecture and code the next developer can maintain.

bullets: Technical lead on a three-app school transport platform (Driver, Supervisor, Parent) built from scratch on Clean Architecture with BLoC/Cubit, freezed unions, injectable DI and go_router.
Shipped background GPS tracking with batched HTTP uploads and an offline outbox, streaming live driver position to parent and supervisor maps over a WebSocket connection.
Built offline-first mapping with flutter_map and FMTC tile caching over server-precomputed route geometry, removing runtime routing API calls and their per-request cost.
Integrated Shorebird code-push across three build flavors on a live production app (~500 active users, both stores), cutting hotfix turnaround from a store review cycle to minutes.
Delivered features for a bilingual (Arabic/English, RTL) education marketplace on GraphQL, including deep-linked payment flows and a wallet and cashback journey.
Prototyped on-device face verification with a FaceNet TFLite model for identity checks without a network round trip.
Led the Flutter team across concurrent client apps, owning architecture decisions, code review standards and the release calendar.
Delivered large-scale e-commerce and gaming apps end to end — first build through store review, launch and post-release maintenance on Google Play and the App Store.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines and Fastlane, automating build, test, code signing and deployment to TestFlight and Google Play.
Standardised the team on a shared BLoC and clean-architecture baseline, so features move between developers without a rewrite.
Mentored junior and mid-level developers through code review and pairing, and ran the team Git branching and delivery workflow.
Built and maintained retail and logistics apps for Android and iOS, including the Stock Client ordering app and the Stock Delivery driver app.
Improved app responsiveness through API pagination, image caching and reduced widget rebuilds.
Integrated REST APIs and Firebase — authentication, push notifications and crash reporting — across production apps.
